description: Pennsylvania sources for the FactLot Registry collector: Philadelphia Office of Property Assessment. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/pa-philadelphia-opa.md.

sources.publisher: City of Philadelphia, Office of Property Assessment (via OpenDataPhilly)
sources.license: 'City of Philadelphia License' (OpenDataPhilly's name for the City's terms of use): the City 'reserves all rights in the database and any data contained therein', provides the data 'as is' without warranty, and says browsing City data constitutes acceptance. It neither grants nor forbids redistribution. OpenDataPhilly's own terms (opendataphilly.org/about/) add no-endorsement and no-liability clauses only. Assessment records are public records in Pennsylvania
sources.redistribution: Not addressed: the City reserves all rights in the database and states no redistribution right; public record. Needs a person's decision before the registry publishes this source
sources.notes: Dataset 'Philadelphia Properties and Assessment History' (table opa_properties_public), rebuilt nightly. Two confirmed files: the full bulk CSV (about 294 MB, 583,722 rows, 78 columns) on opendata-downloads.s3.amazonaws.com, and the same table restricted to the commercial-scope category codes (2,3,4,5,7,9,10,14,15; about 77,000 rows) exported by the City's Carto SQL API on phl.carto.com with the geometry columns skipped. The adapter reads either (it goes by column name). The review run of 2026-11-02 used the Carto extract because the network reached the S3 bucket at about 50 KB/s, which would have taken over 90 minutes for the full file; the weekly archive should use the full file and pass --partial for the extract. A file geodatabase (opa_properties_public.gdb.zip) and an assessment-history table (assessments.csv) are on the same bucket, not archived. robots.txt: opendataphilly.org allows everything; phl.carto.com disallows /api/ only for named search engines; the S3 bucket answers 403 for robots.txt (no rules). Left verified=false because the City's license reserves all rights in the database without stating a redistribution right; the review run used `snapshot --include-unverified` so the record has real counts. Owner names are published (owner_1, owner_2); the registry keeps organisation owners only. Field definitions: metadata.phila.gov dataset 5543865f20583086178c4ee5 (a JavaScript application; the code tables were read from the category_code_description and building_code_description columns of the data itself).
